text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over these past three years,
Vivlos has pushed ahead on the Tiara route...
and achieved incredible results.
choice_data_list: (I want to do something to celebrate for her.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To please her love for all things flashy,
I decided to book the entire restaurant, invite guests,
and throw a lavish celebrity party—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you for gathering here today!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheers♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The invitations were sent to the Umamusume who, like Verxina, had made their mark on the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work over these past three years,
Vivlos-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If it's you, I'm sure you'll achieve great things
no matter what country you race in♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower, who brought massive victories with her small frame. Fine Motion, who came all the way from Ireland and left an indelible impression.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what kind of magic did you use?
...I wouldn't mind trading secrets with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho, who had also once been named
Best Senior Queen Umamusume,
stacking up victories in her own willful way.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Magic?
Huh, I wonder what it is~?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe it's... love?
Ehehe♡"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by glamorous friends, Vivlos is chatting happily. The party is going smoothly so far. All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Oh, right, Trai-chi!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey,
Train-y~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~â¡ Trainie, that's awesome~!
Total! Competent boss vibes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be treated like a high-class lady"—
that was the request Vivlos made when we talked about throwing a party.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, isn't this suit great!?
The silk sheen is subtle yet luxurious,
and that vibrant blue is gorgeous~!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Looks great.
It's definitely gonna suit you, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I tried suuuper hard on the Tiara route, so that makes me suuuper high-class, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Like, I want Trainy to protect me like a cool hero♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Have fun trying it on, okay?
I'll be waiting~♡"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it felt like I was being toyed with a bit,
I went along with her and prepared everything, thinking that if it's what Vivlos wants to do, so be it—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah! Fine-san, you're a total legit celeb, right? So how's Trainy's quality looking!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given her background, Fine Motion has likely seen all sorts of people.
Being evaluated by someone like her is a heavy burden, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Wouldn't you say she makes for a truly wonderful retainer?♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~, I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Because I can really feel
how much they care for "Ojousama."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Just from the way they carried themselves today, I can tell... what kind of path those two walked toward glory♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... can you tell?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yes! My Trainy cares soooo much about me, and is sooo sweet to me♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainy!
Could you serve our guests, please~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's show everyone how completely
flawless and sharp we look♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the lively party went on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I was reminiscing about that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I'm late...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, to be late for the ball!
I am completely disqualified as a princess~!
choice_data_list: It's just a casual get-together, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The newly arrived ones were Mejiro Dober,
Kawakami Princess, and Daiwa Scarlet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All of them achieved great results,
winning two of the Tiara crowns.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You guys came too!
I'm super happy♡

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Winning so many races on the Triple Tiara route,
and at the GⅠ level at that?! That's incredible!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because I was running down the exact same road, I know.
You're the number one of "right now."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Scarlet-san...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Judging by the way you said that,
are you fired up quite a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you figure it out?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Having someone else be number one besides me...
I just hate the thought of it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Our celebration is... none other than a bare-knuckle brawl! A race, that is~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I got a little delayed getting that ready...
Of course, that's only if you're up for it, Vivlos."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Still... racing someone who's won this much on
the Tiara path... is something I want to do too."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...It all started with me chasing after my big sister, but..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I knew it,
the Tiara route is so cool♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's my Trai-chi for ya!
Yeah, I'll happily accept everyone's congratulations♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the party moved to a new venue...
and continued glamorously until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Is the party venue over here, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Mejiro Ramonu...
The very first to achieve the Triple Tiara,
a bewitching Umamusume who captivates everyone's gaze—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy,
you even invited Ramonu-san!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I was interested.
—In you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Seven GⅠ victories along the Tiara route...
That is truly a historic achievement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"May I uncover the secret...
behind how you reached such distant heights?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ummm...? 
...Trainy~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I ponder the question as Vivlos looks to me for help. She undoubtedly achieved a great feat. And the reason for that is simply—
choice_data_list: Maybe because Vivlos worked so hard

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!
Trainy...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...If that's the case,
I think Trainy is the secret!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You listened to all my selfish requests...
and worked so hard right beside me!
That's why I—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――... Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It was a culmination born
precisely because of "you all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take my leave.
—Next time, on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Ramonu-san really is
a mystery, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainy.
I'm done playing rich girl."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for being so selfish, okay?
But...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
After all,
I love the usual Trainie the best♡
